evals.prompt: I'm working on my stackai project and need you to spawn a virtual agent to implement OAuth2 authentication with JWT tokens in the API. Use branch feat/oauth2.
evals.expected_output: Claude constructs a feature-type task prompt, sanitizes the branch name (feat/oauth2 → feat-oauth2 for container naming), identifies the git root, sets WORKTREES_DIR to the parent of git root + /.worktrees, and runs container run -d --rm with correct flags: --worktree feat/oauth2, --task containing the feature prompt, -v mounts for workspace and worktrees, -e for CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Confirms the container started and shows how to follow logs.
expectations: Runs `container run -d` (detached mode, not -it)
Uses --worktree feat/oauth2 argument passed to entrypoint
Sanitizes branch to feat-oauth2 in the container name
Mounts a worktrees directory as a separate -v volume (not a named volume)
Passes CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN as an environment variable
Task prompt is feature-type: mentions 'senior software engineer' or equivalent, asks for clean/tested code
Shows command to follow logs after spawning (container logs -f or equivalent)

evals.prompt: Spawn an agent to write unit tests for the payment service module. Branch: test/payment-service
evals.expected_output: Claude builds a test-type task prompt (QA engineer framing, coverage focus), launches the container in detached mode with the test/payment-service branch. Container name sanitized to test-payment-service.
expectations: Runs `container run -d` (detached mode)
Uses --worktree test/payment-service
Task prompt has testing focus: mentions coverage, edge cases, or 'QA engineer'
Does NOT use a feature-type or mutation-type prompt
Container name derived from test/payment-service (sanitized, no /)

evals.prompt: Show me what agents are currently running. Also list the worktrees that exist.
evals.expected_output: Claude runs container list filtered by the project prefix (qubits-team), and also lists the worktrees directory. Shows the results in a readable format.
expectations: Runs `container list` (not `container ps` or other docker-style commands)
Filters output by project prefix (e.g., grep qubits-team)
Also shows worktrees on disk (ls on WORKTREES_DIR or equivalent)
Does NOT attempt to spawn a new agent

evals.prompt: Check what the feat/oauth2 agent is doing right now. Give me a summary of its progress.
evals.expected_output: Claude checks status.json from the worktree for quick status, and/or reads container logs (sanitized name feat-oauth2). Provides a plain-language summary — not just a raw log dump.
expectations: Reads status.json from $AGENTS_HOME/feat/oauth2/.agent/ OR runs `container logs`
Uses correct sanitized container name if using container logs: includes feat-oauth2
Provides a summary or interpretation, not just raw output
Does NOT spawn a new container

evals.prompt: The feat/oauth2 agent finished a while ago. What was the result? Did it succeed?
evals.expected_output: Claude reads status.json from the persisted worktree directory. Reports the phase (completed/errored), exit code, commit count, and duration. Does NOT attempt container logs on a stopped container.
expectations: Reads status.json from $AGENTS_HOME/feat/oauth2/.agent/status.json
Reports phase, exit code, and commit count from the status file
Does NOT attempt `container logs` on a container that no longer exists
Does NOT show error messages about missing containers

evals.prompt: Show me the full logs from the feat/oauth2 agent. It finished already.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the persisted agent.log from the worktree directory. Shows the saved logs with a note that these are persisted logs from a finished agent.
expectations: Reads from $AGENTS_HOME/feat/oauth2/.agent/agent.log (persisted logs)
Does NOT attempt `container logs` as the primary source for a finished agent
Indicates these are saved/persisted logs
Does NOT show confusing error output about missing containers

evals.prompt: The feat/oauth2 agent finished. Merge its work into my current branch.
evals.expected_output: Claude uses git merge feat/oauth2 from the current branch. Never copies files from the worktree directory. Confirms the merge was successful and summarizes what was integrated. If conflicts arise, reports them to the user.
expectations: Runs `git merge feat/oauth2` (not cp, rsync, or checkout of individual files)
Does NOT copy files from the worktree directory
Does NOT run git log from the worktree directory on host (container path in .git)
Reports conflicts to user if any, instead of resolving silently
Does NOT delete the agent branch or worktree unless user asks

evals.prompt: Both agents are done — feat/oauth2 and test/auth-tests. Create a branch called integration/auth and merge both into it.
evals.expected_output: Claude creates a new branch integration/auth, then merges feat/oauth2 and test/auth-tests sequentially using git merge. Never copies files from worktree directories. Reports success and shows a summary of the combined branch.
expectations: Runs `git checkout -b integration/auth` to create the combined branch
Merges each branch sequentially with `git merge` (not a single squash or cherry-pick)
Does NOT copy files from worktree directories
Stops and reports to user if a conflict occurs during any merge
Does NOT delete original agent branches unless user explicitly asks

evals.prompt: Spawn a PI agent (local mlx_lm backend) to investigate the auth module and propose refactors. Branch pi/auth-debug.
evals.expected_output: Claude detects this is a PI agent (uses the local mlx_lm.server), runs `make spawn-pi` (or `q pi spawn`) with BRANCH=pi/auth-debug and a feature-style task prompt. Reminds the user to ensure the local server is running via `uv run iac server status`. Does NOT use the Claude `spawn` target, does NOT pass CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
expectations: Uses the PI-specific target: `spawn-pi` (Makefile) or `q pi spawn` (CLI)
Container name pattern includes `-pi-` (sanitized branch under PI namespace)
Does NOT pass CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN — PI agents authenticate against the local model
Mentions or checks that mlx_lm.server is running (e.g. `uv run iac server status`)
Warns the user about MAX_PI_AGENTS=1 if they ask for more than one PI agent at once

evals.prompt: Show me the PI agents currently running. I want to know which ones are using the local model.
evals.expected_output: Claude lists only PI agents (containers matching `*-pi-*` or worktrees with agent_kind=pi in status.json). Uses `make list-pi-agents` or `q pi list`. Does NOT include regular Claude agents in the output.
expectations: Uses `list-pi-agents` target or `q pi list` command (not the generic `list-agents`)
Filters by PI containers (name includes `-pi-`) or PI worktrees (agent_kind=pi)
Does NOT spawn a new container
Output clearly distinguishes PI agents from Claude agents

evals.prompt: The pi/auth-debug PI agent finished. Stop the container and tell me what it did.
evals.expected_output: Claude stops the PI container with `make stop-pi-agent BRANCH=pi/auth-debug` (or `q pi stop --branch pi/auth-debug`), then reads the persisted status.json from the worktree to summarize phase, exit code, commits. Does NOT call `stop-agent` (the Claude target).
expectations: Uses `stop-pi-agent` target (not `stop-agent`)
Reads `.agent/status.json` from the worktree to summarize results
Reports phase, exit code, and commit count
Does NOT attempt `container logs` on a stopped container
